# SectionHeader

A section title with an optional trailing link, used above every carousel and list.

`TVTracker.SectionHeader` · Layout

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.SectionHeader title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.SectionHeader" title="…"></x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `action` | `string` | Optional trailing link text, e.g. "See all". |
| `actionHref` | `string` | Makes the action a link (e.g. to the See all list). |
| `onAction` | `() => void` |  |
